title: Internship: Industrial Product Design (February–June 2027)
note: Full-time, 40-hour internship at a Dutch lighting and furniture design house; open to industrial product design students (not a graduation internship), English required.

facts.summary: Five-month hands-on product design internship at an Amsterdam lighting and furniture brand, split between the Amsterdam studio and Almere workshop.
facts.duties: 3D CAD modeling and sketching, prototype testing, 3D printing and assembly, taking products from sketch to production, managing own projects, talking with suppliers, occasionally helping build trade-fair stands abroad.
facts.requirements: Studying industrial product design or similar; SolidWorks and Rhino (or willing to learn); InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop; some prototyping/3D printing experience; good English; Arduino/electronics a bonus.
facts.apply: Apply on the Homerun page with CV and portfolio uploads.
